configuration.title: InfiniAI Provider for VS Code
configuration.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API. The extension appends '/chat/completions' to this value for chat requests.
configuration.anthropic.baseUrl.descript: Base URL for the Anthropic-compatible API. The extension appends '/v1/messages' to this value for chat requests.
configuration.retry.description: Retry configuration for retryable network failures and HTTP [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].
configuration.retry.enabled.description: Enable retry mechanism for api errors. Default is true.
configuration.retry.maxAttempts.descript: Maximum total number of attempts, including the first request. Default is 3.
configuration.retry.intervalMs.descripti: Interval between retry attempts in milliseconds. Default is 1000 (1 second).
configuration.retry.statusCodes.descript: Additional HTTP status codes to merge with the default retryable list [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].
configuration.delay.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds between consecutive requests. Default is 0 (no delay).
configuration.modelDiscoveryUrl.descript: Optional absolute URL for model discovery. Empty uses the default InfiniAI endpoint.
configuration.modelDiscoveryTimeoutMs.de: Maximum time in milliseconds for the complete model discovery response, including body parsing.
configuration.modelCacheTtlMs.descriptio: How long to cache discovered models. Set 0 to refresh every request.
configuration.hiddenModels.description: InfiniAI provider filter: model IDs omitted before VS Code receives the provider list. This is separate from VS Code Manage Models visibility. Omitted models remain visible in the InfiniAI Models view and can be included again there.
configuration.hiddenModelPatterns.descri: InfiniAI provider filter: model ID patterns omitted before VS Code receives the provider list. This is separate from VS Code Manage Models visibility. Supports '*' wildcards and case-insensitive matching. Defaults omit image/video generation families such as vidu, seedream, seedance, image, diffusion, hailuo, and kling.
configuration.visibleModels.description: InfiniAI provider filter: model IDs forced into the list sent to VS Code, overriding 'infiniai.hiddenModels' and 'infiniai.hiddenModelPatterns'. VS Code Manage Models visibility still applies separately.
configuration.modelRoutes.description: Route matching overrides for model transports. The first matching pattern wins.
configuration.imageInputModels.descripti: Force-enable image input for specific model IDs. Supports '*' wildcard patterns (e.g. 'kimi-*'). Useful when a multimodal model doesn't include a name marker like '-vision'.
configuration.disableImageInputModels.de: Force-disable image input for specific model IDs. Supports '*' wildcard patterns.
configuration.toolCallingModels.descript: Force-enable tool calling and VS Code Agent eligibility for matching model IDs. Supports '*' wildcard patterns. The extension already has evidence-based fallbacks for probed DeepSeek V4 and MiMo variants whose catalog rows do not advertise tool support; explicit live or catalog metadata remains authoritative unless you add an override here.
configuration.disableToolCallingModels.d: Force-disable tool calling and VS Code Agent eligibility for matching model IDs. Supports '*' wildcard patterns and wins over 'infiniai.toolCallingModels'. Unknown models default to disabled unless metadata or an enable override confirms support.
configuration.disableThinkingForModels.d: Safety list. Thinking mode is force-disabled for matching model IDs to avoid known reasoning_content HTTP 400 errors. The built-in safety defaults always include known Xiaomi MiMo V2 model IDs and the DeepSeek V4 family. Usually leave this unchanged; add patterns only when another model has the same issue. Supports '*' wildcards; comparisons are case-insensitive.
configuration.enableThinkingRoundTripFor: Round-trip replay list. Kimi and DeepSeek V4 defaults use exact verified IDs: Kimi uses 'kimi-k2-thinking', 'kimi-k2.5', 'kimi-k2.6', 'kimi-k2.7-code', 'kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed', and 'kimi-k3'; DeepSeek V4 uses 'deepseek-v4-pro' and 'deepseek-v4-flash'. Other defaults include 'mimo-v2*', exact 'deepseek-r1', exact 'deepseek-v3.2-thinking', 'glm-5*', 'glm-4.7*', and 'minimax*'. Known adapters preserve provider-native shapes. Kimi K2.7 Code and K3 replay every historical assistant message, while tool-call profiles use call IDs. If replay preflight cannot prove the required context is available, the extension fails locally. Supports '*' wildcards; comparisons are case-insensitive. Replay storage is controlled by infiniai.thinkingReplayStore.
configuration.thinkingReplayStore.descri: Storage backend for thinking replay when a model profile or infiniai.enableThinkingRoundTripForModels enables round-trip. 'localPlaintext' persists replay data in a local plaintext extension-storage file for restart continuity. 'memory' writes no replay data to disk and cannot resume replay-sensitive conversations after VS Code reload or restart.
configuration.thinkingReplayStore.enum.l: Default. Store replay data in a local plaintext extension-storage file so replay-sensitive conversations can continue after VS Code reload or restart while cache entries remain valid.
configuration.thinkingReplayStore.enum.m: Keep replay data only in process memory. No replay cache file is written, but replay-sensitive conversations cannot be resumed after VS Code reload or restart.
